description: This file is a PHP source code file defining the 'Information' controller class within the Opencart system, specifically handling information display and retrieval for the catalog module.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for handling information pages in the Catalog module, providing methods for displaying detailed information and summary views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main page display of an information item, retrieving data based on the 'information_id' request parameter, setting page metadata, breadcrumbs, and loading the view template.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides a detailed view of a specific information item, including setting response headers to prevent indexing and rendering the information content.
